honest_boundary: No manifold-level Ricci flow, surgery construction, canonical-neighborhood theorem, kappa-noncollapsing theorem or extinction theorem is proved or constructed.
SphericalPiece records the compact-spherical alternative of the D7 canonical-neighborhood certificate; the smooth positive-curvature geometry is not formalized.
The connected-sum relation is an opaque Prop field; van Kampen and the connected-sum computation are function fields, not theorems.
missingFinalHomeomorphismConstruction, missingMoiseSmoothingBridge and missingGeometrizationOutput are statement-only Props, never asserted as theorems.
finalHomeomorphismConstruction_of_certificateFamily is conditional on a certificate family for every admissible manifold; it does not prove the Poincare conjecture.
The sibling task D7-surgery-neck-extinction (Poincare/D7/SurgeryFlow/) was running concurrently and is not imported; an adapter is future work.
